title: Capability observation
description: One thing actually seen. Without this record type provenance DIAGNOSTIC could never be truthful, which is why both committed profiles say UNKNOWN: observation_refs pointed at a record type that did not exist.

capability_ref.description: The one capability this observation is about.

method.description: How it was observed -- which task was set, under what conditions.

observed.description: What the learner actually did or produced.

independence.description: Whether the learner had help, and what kind. Seeing a worked solution is not evidence of independent mastery.
